courses.title: Project Management for Conservation Programmes
courses.description: Project Management for Conservation Programmes takes you from the basics of project management to applying it on a realistic Conservation Programme Manager scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to field data collection, enough to use it alongside project management day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying project management to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing project management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to field data collection
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Environmental Impact Assessment for Practitioners
courses.description: Environmental Impact Assessment for Practitioners is a focused course on environmental impact assessment for people already working toward a Conservation Programme Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying environmental impact assessment on your own.

courses.description: Habitat Restoration Basics is a short introduction to habitat restoration for people moving toward a Conservation Programme Manager role. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if habitat restoration is new to you.

alternates.title: Project Management Essentials
alternates.description: Project Management Essentials walks you through the basics of project management, built for people new to Conservation Programme Manager work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of project management, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying project management to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing project management through guided exercises
Building a short project management exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Project Management Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Project Management Techniques goes beyond the basics of project management, for people already working toward a Conservation Programme Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in project management and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying project management to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing project management through guided exercises
Building a short project management exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
